action.public_message: Selling all my houses to raise cash.
action.private_thought: Need to raise cash to pay 1670 rent. I have 64 cash, short 1650. Can sell houses on my six monopolies. Selling all 18 houses yields $1125 (orange $50 each, red $75 each). This is the maximum cash now; later I can mortgage properties. So sell all houses on each property.
